owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.title: Schema and both entry points
requirements: every field read anywhere is in the schema
install and activate run the same validator
the header comment matches what a licence may carry

installLicense refuses a licence carrying name, email or machine exactly as activateLicense does, and writes no file; the test installs such a licence from file and asserts the refusal (the twin measured install writing a licence that activate refuses: src/cli/licensing.mjs:148-151 never calls extraFields, :90 does)
a trial licence and an org licence install from file and activate by key under the same rule; the schema header states which non-identity fields (trial, org, trial_ext) a licence may carry

the schema check lives in verifyLicense, so install, activate, loadLicense and every reader apply one rule; the trial rules (one trial per organisation, a trial never replaces a live paid licence) live in one function that install and activate both call

the relay default that the activation server sends beside the licence (the wrapper's relay object) is the one unsigned exception: the schema lists it as a wrapper field; it is typed and validated (default_url a relay://host:port address exactly as src/cli/relay.mjs accepts it, default_domain a domain name (two or more labels of 1 to 63 letters, digits or hyphens, none starting or ending with a hyphen, and not an IP address), nothing else); it is applied only by activateLicense, only after the licence and the wrapper are accepted, and only when no relay is configured (configured: a relay url is set, enabled or not, or a default_url is already stored); installLicense never applies a relay object read from a file and prints a warning naming relay; a default is stored whole or not at all; a malformed value is ignored with a warning and activation still succeeds; docs state that it is unsigned; every field read from the licence itself is a signed schema field
a trial licence must carry org, so the one-trial-per-organisation rule cannot be sidestepped by leaving org out; existing fixtures that build a trial without org gain one
keys that name Object.prototype members (__proto__, constructor, toString) are unknown fields, and an org of that name never reaches a prototype through the trial record

an expired licence is accepted by both installLicense and activateLicense in a fresh config dir (test/trial-convert.test.mjs installs an expired trial there) and refused by both, with the same reason, while a live licence or a live trial is installed; a not-yet-valid licence is refused by both; docs/PRICING.md says so
org matches exactly /^org_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,64}$/, so no prototype member name and no e-mail address can be an org
install and activate store the licence object alone, written again from the verified licence (no wrapper, no byte-order mark, no padding), so loadLicense reads back exactly what was accepted
the trial record is written before license.json, and a failure writing it refuses the install or the activation with no licence written
the size limit is measured in UTF-8 bytes on both paths
verifyLicense returns trial, org and trial_ext with the other fields it returns, so every reader of the verified licence can apply the trial-in-grace rule that src/engine/merge.mjs applies

verifyLicense takes floor, the latest time this vault recorded, and judges exp and grace at the later of now and floor, so winding the clock back does not revive a lapsed trial or licence (MEM-129 AC05); loadLicense keeps the floor in license-clock.json in the config directory, raising it to now on each check and never lowering it, and passes it to verifyLicense; engineAllowed in src/engine/merge.mjs passes the same floor
